ranked_headroom.1_root_reduce_eltwise: 116us on the root vs a ~15-30us eltwise roofline (384 bfp8 tile-adds + 48 SiLU tiles). 4 SEQUENTIAL child round trips at ~(4us transfer + 20us add). 208 ns/tile = ~281 cycles/tile against ~34-70. HEADROOM ~86-100us. This is the textbook eltwise_l1_vs_dest_accumulate RMW anti-pattern: cb_gate_acc/cb_up_acc are bfloat8_b and are UNPACKED+ADDED+PACKED once per child.

ranked_headroom.3_gateup_reduce_serialisation: gateup(54) and reduce(116) are STRICTLY SERIAL on the root — op_design.md 4.3s per-sub-block overlap was never built (R2 turned HN_BLOCK but not the reduce split). HEADROOM up to 54us.

roofline_gates.weight_dram_stream: GATED OUT. 24.772 MB of bfp4 at 512 GB/s = 48.4us floor; measured incremental 50.6us = 1.04x roofline. At the DRAM roofline — no headroom. Kills the WRUN / dual-NoC / prefetch-depth idea class (consistent with R2/R3 having already measured those null).

roofline_gates.h_all_gather: GATED OUT as a transport. 14.1us incremental for 11 rounds of a 110-core rendezvous + 11x52KB mcast = 1.3us/round. Cheap. reader_phase2s 143us wall is WAITING FOR THE ROOTS, not transport.

conclusion: The op is NOT transport-bound and NOT weight-DRAM-bound. It is bound by the SERIAL ELTWISE WORK ON 11 OF 110 CORES. 70% of the idea budget goes to the root reduce.

what: Two-phase REDUCE-SCATTER of the gate/up cross-column reduce, with the SwiGLU epilogue DISTRIBUTED and the h gather fused straight into cb_h_local
mechanism: every core in a grid column owns a disjoint FLAT TILE-INDEX slice of the m_eff*HN_PAD block; every contributor pushes its slice into each worker landing CB; each worker reduces only its own slice over all contributors, computes SiLU(gate_slice)*up_slice, and unicasts the finished h slice directly into the root cb_h_local at its tile offset. The gather IS the assembly - no copy and no add at the root. cb_gate_send/cb_up_send and the two full-block copies on 99 cores are deleted; the writer sends straight out of cb_gate_acc/cb_up_acc.
predicate: UNCONDITIONAL over the whole SUPPORTED set. Host asserts and falls back to the BYTE-IDENTICAL tree (printing the reason) when the slice plan is not expressible: KGROUPS >= 2, and for EVERY reachable m_eff the slice size must divide both the slice CBs and the landing CBs (violating that page-count rule makes the write pointer wrap mid-block and SILENTLY overrun the next CB - measured PCC 0.709-0.886). Verified expressible for HN_PAD {4,6} x KGROUPS {2,4,8,10}. MOE_SWIGLU_REDUCE=tree|scatter is the live A/B; MOE_SWIGLU_SCATTER_NOC=split|one likewise.

did_not_transfer: bfp8 slice accumulators passed golden 45/45 but FAILED test_emb_contraction at max rel 0.0580 vs the 0.05 gate. The bfp8 pack rounding is a BIASED half-LSB and every partial here is positive, so the error is LINEAR IN CHAIN LENGTH - the scatter re-packs a value KGROUPS=10 times where the tree re-packs it ceil(log2 10)=4. The bench PCC metric (0.999777 vs 0.999823) hid it completely; only the structural test max-relative-error on a pathological input exposed it. Fix: the three slice CBs are bfloat16 (DEST is bf16 at fp32_dest_acc_en=False so that pack is EXACT, deleting the per-step quantisation rather than reducing it) -> 0.0204, bit-identical to the tree, for +17,280 B/core. Precision contract untouched: an intermediate CB format is an implementation choice, not a user knob.
